framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandates disclosure of acquisition of shares or voting rights beyond prescribed thresholds (25%, 26%, etc.) or assumption of control; triggers applicability of open offer provisions under Reg 3–6.

Defines 'Acquisition' and 'control'; applies when person(s) acquire shares exceeding threshold or exercise effective control, triggering mandatory open offer at no less than highest price paid in prior 26 weeks.
Exemptions to mandatory open offer; includes creeping acquisition (≤5% per financial year for persons already holding 25%+), acquisition of whole company, or regulatory approval.

framework.note: Grants SEBI power to issue regulations for prevention of fraudulent and unfair trade practices in securities market, including acquisition and takeovers.
